notes: REF-BM-02: no metadata fetching whatsoever; title/description entered manually, no favicon/preview collection. REF-BM-03: title/description are editable before (add form) and after (PUT/edit form) saving, but there is no auto-collection to edit, so only the manual-edit facet exists. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable via PUT+edit form, but note field does not exist in the model. REF-BM-06: createBookmark always INSERTs with no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-07: list shows title/description/tags but no favicon (not stored/rendered). REF-BM-10: tags input is a plain text field with no autocomplete of existing tags. REF-BM-12: LIKE search covers title/description/url (and tags) but no note field exists to search. REF-BM-14: '#tag' is treated as literal LIKE text, no tag-syntax parsing. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesis parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag, no unread view, no mark-as-read. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: sort fixed to created_at DESC, no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: no markdown note storage/rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag, no archive-vs-delete distinction, no archive view. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (sort/items/font size).
